name: stats-section-v5
title: Stats Section v5
description: A response-time stats section written for non-technical readers. The title sits on the left and a plain-language description on the right. Below them, a histogram of response times, colored green, amber and red by speed with a matching strip along the axis, has dashed lines marking the typical response time and the time 99% of requests finish under. Hovering a bar shows what share of requests finished by then and highlights the matching line. Four stats sit under the chart in a fully bordered, square-cornered grid. Static data, no API.
